title: Utah Beach to Cherbourg (6 June – 27 June 1944) (American Forces in Action series)
author: Roland G. Ruppenthal
publisher: Historical Division, Department of the Army
notes: ONLY THE MAP SHEETS HAVE BEEN READ, NOT THE TEXT. The URL is the Wikimedia Commons scan of Map VII ('Utah Beach: 8th Infantry Landing Plan', file revision 913116035), whose description gives the source as this book, 1947, 'one of a collection included with the book in a map envelope'; the original file was downloaded and read for issue #11. Cite only map content, with a locator such as 'Map VII'. The book's text could not be read from the drafting session: history.army.mil refuses automated fetches (#3), and www.ibiblio.org and archive.org were refused by the session's network proxy (HTTP 403). Author and OCLC 11928372 are from the English Wikipedia 'Utah Beach' article's Further reading list (revision 1372907065). A different Commons scan from the same book (File:USA-A-Utah-p7b.jpg) gives the publisher as 'Historical Division, War Department' and the date as 1948; the edition and year should be confirmed by a human against a copy of the book.
